meta.description: Directory of the 50 ICAR Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs) in Maharashtra (ICAR-ATARI Zone VIII, Pune), for the TerraByte farmer app. Fields are filled only from credible sources; anything not found is null.

sources.name: ICAR Maharashtra KVK list (49 rows; backbone for address, host, year of sanction)
ICAR-ATARI Pune: Contact details of KVKs (Zone VIII), PDF created 2023-04-13, lists all 50 Maharashtra KVKs
ICAR-ATARI Pune: KVKs of ATARI page (50 in Maharashtra)
ICAR-ATARI Pune: Land holding of KVKs (50 Maharashtra KVKs incl. Thane and Palghar)
ICAR-ATARI Pune: NGO-KVK chairpersons contact details (19.6.24)
MPKV Rahuri KVK page (17 KVKs in western Maharashtra)
Dr. PDKV Akola KVK page (Vidarbha KVKs, establishment dates, websites)
Dr. BSKKV Dapoli KVK profiles (Lanja, Roha)
MAFSU Nagpur homepage (links KVK sites thane/nagpur2/sangli2.kvk8.in) and 14th ECEC minutes
Individual KVK websites (as cited per record)
India Post pincode data via api.postalpincode.in (used only to choose between two conflicting official pincodes)

notes: ICAR node/15040 lists 49 Maharashtra KVKs. The 50th is KVK Thane at Nagaon, Tal. Murbad, hosted by MAFSU Nagpur. It is confirmed by the ATARI Pune contact list (#50), ATARI land-holding table, MAFSU minutes and the KVK website. Its sanction year was not found.
ataripune.icar.gov.in and kvk.icar.gov.in did not resolve on 2026-11-24. ATARI documents were read from Internet Archive snapshots (2024), so phone/email from them may be up to ~3 years old.

phone holds office numbers published for the KVK: office lines from the ATARI list, numbers in the ATARI "Office" column, or contact numbers on host-university or KVK pages. Personal mobile numbers that ATARI lists separately for named Programme Coordinators were deliberately left out. Where sources disagree, current host or KVK pages are preferred, and the difference is recorded in notes.

icar_sno is the serial number in ICAR node/15040; atari_label is the ATARI designation (e.g. Pune-I). Two KVKs have moved from the address ICAR still shows: Raigad (ICAR: Karjat; now Killa-Dhatav, Roha) and Ratnagiri (ICAR: Shirgaon; now Deodhe, Lanja).

District names are current: Ahilyanagar (formerly Ahmednagar), Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (formerly Aurangabad), Dharashiv (formerly Osmanabad), and Palghar (carved from Thane in 2014). VNMKV Parbhani was formerly Marathwada Agricultural University.

Coordinates: only 2 are published by the KVK itself (Wardha, Nagpur-I) and 1 is an OSM-mapped KVK feature (Sagroli). The rest are OSM centroids of the village, town or city named in the address, NOT the KVK campus; coords_precision says which. Use them for "near X" display, not navigation. Ambiguous geocodes (same-named village elsewhere, post-office village only, dam or railway station) were rejected and left null.
host_type: SAU = state agricultural/veterinary university (incl. MAFSU); NGO; ICAR = ICAR institute; OEI = other educational institution (YCMOU).
